name: query.runtime.maxrow
description: Maximum rows a query may return at runtime. 0 or blank means unlimited. Lowering it truncates large query results and shows a warning in viewsheets.

name: log.detail.level
description: Global log detail level. 'debug' is verbose and can grow log storage quickly; 'off' disables logging.

name: mail.smtp.host
description: Outgoing SMTP host used for scheduled reports and alerts. A wrong value fails delivery silently until the next send.

name: security.exposedefaultorgtoall
description: Exposes the default organization's assets to all users. Changing it fires repository side effects and alters what every user can see.

name: openid.audience
description: openid.audience is the expected aud claim value that OpenIDFilterBaseFilter.createSessionFromToken requires on every verified ID token, and has no declared default.

name: openid.authorization.endpoint
description: openid.authorization.endpoint is the URL of the identity provider's OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint — the address a user's browser is redirected to first, to begin an OpenID Connect login — and has no declared default.

name: openid.callback.url
description: openid.callback.url is not a URL on the identity provider at all — it is the context-relative path on this StyleBI server that receives the provider's redirect after login, and defaults, when unset, to /openid/login.

name: openid.client.id
description: openid.client.id is the client identifier StyleBI registered with the identity provider for this OpenID application, and has no declared default.

name: openid.client.secret
description: openid.client.secret is the client secret StyleBI presents to the identity provider's token endpoint, and has no declared default.

name: openid.group.claim
description: openid.group.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads to assign StyleBI groups to a logging-in user, and has no declared default.

name: openid.issuer
description: openid.issuer is the identity provider's issuer identifier, checked against the returned ID token's iss claim after the token is already parsed — unlike the endpoint properties, it never builds a URL StyleBI calls — and has no declared default.

name: openid.jwk.cert
description: openid.jwk.cert holds a PEM-encoded certificate StyleBI parses into a local signature-verification key, used only as a fallback when openid.jwks.uri is unset, and has no declared default.

name: openid.jwks.uri
description: openid.jwks.uri is the URL of the identity provider's JSON Web Key Set — fetched only after a token comes back, to verify the token's signature, not to start the login — and has no declared default.

name: openid.name.claim
description: openid.name.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads as the logging-in user's identity, and defaults, when unset, to email.

name: openid.orgid.claim
description: openid.orgid.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads to place a logging-in user in a StyleBI organization, and has no declared default.

name: openid.postprocessor
description: openid.postprocessor is meant to name a class StyleBI instantiates to adjust the SRPrincipal built from an OpenID login, given the token's claims, and is unset by default.

name: openid.property.provider
description: openid.property.provider names a class StyleBI instantiates to compute the OpenID configuration for each request, overriding the stored OpenIDConfig values, and is unset by default, so no override runs.

name: openid.role.claim
description: openid.role.claim names the ID-token claim StyleBI reads to assign StyleBI roles to a logging-in user, and has no declared default.

name: openid.scopes
description: openid.scopes is the space-separated list of OAuth scopes StyleBI requests in the authorization redirect — a request parameter sent alongside the endpoint URLs, not an address or key of its own — and defaults, when unset, to openid email.

name: openid.token.endpoint
description: openid.token.endpoint is the URL of the identity provider's OAuth 2.0 token endpoint — the address this StyleBI server itself calls, server to server, to exchange an authorization code for an ID token — and has no declared default.

name: double.sso
description: double.sso is the Allow Default Form Login checkbox on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — it keeps StyleBI's own login form reachable while single sign-on is active, instead of every request being handed to the SSO provider.

name: sso.custom.class
description: sso.custom.class is the fully-qualified Java class name of a custom Filter implementation, and has no declared default.

name: sso.default.roles
description: sso.default.roles is a comma-separated list of role names granted to every user on their first SSO login, and has no declared default.

name: sso.heartbeat.url
description: sso.heartbeat.url is a URL the client is told to poll to detect that an SSO session has ended elsewhere, and has no declared default.

name: sso.logout.path
description: sso.logout.path is the application path the identity provider's own single sign-out request targets, and has no declared default.

name: sso.logout.url
description: sso.logout.url is the Single Sign-Out URL the portal's and EM's Log Out control sends the browser to, and has no declared default.

name: sso.protocol.type
description: sso.protocol.type selects the active SSO mechanism. Unset or unrecognised reads as NONE, so a typo silently disables single sign-on; this catalog entry rejects one instead.

name: sso.rsa.private.key
description: sso.rsa.private.key is the Base64-encoded, master-key-encrypted RSA private key SSOTokenService uses to sign cross-app SSO JWTs, and has no declared default.

name: sso.rsa.public.key
description: sso.rsa.public.key is the Base64-encoded RSA public key paired with sso.rsa.private.key, and has no declared default.

name: stylebi.google.openid.client.id
description: stylebi.google.openid.client.id is the Client ID field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Sign In With Google page — the OAuth client ID StyleBI was issued when its Google project was registered — and has no declared default.

name: stylebi.google.openid.scopes
description: stylebi.google.openid.scopes is the Scopes field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > Sign In With Google page — the OAuth scopes StyleBI asks Google for when a visitor signs in — and defaults to openid email profile.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.entityid
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.entityid is the identity provider's SAML entity ID, checked as the issuer of every incoming SAML message, and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_logout_service.url
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_logout_service.url is the identity provider's Single Logout Service endpoint — where this server sends a SAML LogoutRequest on logout — and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_sign_on_service.url
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.single_sign_on_service.url is the identity provider's Single Sign-On Service endpoint — where this server redirects a user to start SAML login — and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.idp.x509cert
description: onelogin.saml2.idp.x509cert is the identity provider's PEM-encoded signing certificate, used to verify every SAML response and logout message it signs, and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.sp.assertion_consumer_service.url
description: onelogin.saml2.sp.assertion_consumer_service.url is the callback URL where the identity provider must POST the SAML response after login — the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL — and has no declared default.

name: onelogin.saml2.sp.entityid
description: onelogin.saml2.sp.entityid is this server's SAML Service Provider entity ID, sent to the identity provider, and has no declared default.

name: saml.groups.attribute
description: saml.groups.attribute is the Group Claim field of the SAML form on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — the name of the assertion attribute StyleBI reads to put a user logging in through SAML into groups — and has no declared default.

name: saml.orgid.attribute
description: saml.orgid.attribute is the Organization Id Claim field of the SAML form on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — the name of the assertion attribute StyleBI reads to decide which organization a user logging in through SAML belongs to — and has no declared default.

name: saml.roles.attribute
description: saml.roles.attribute is the Role Claim field of the SAML form on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Security > SSO page — the name of the assertion attribute StyleBI reads to assign roles to a user logging in through SAML — and has no declared default.

name: auth0.client.id
description: auth0.client.id is the OAuth client identifier a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.client.secret
description: auth0.client.secret is the OAuth client secret a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.domain
description: auth0.domain is the Auth0 tenant domain a legacy installation stored to build its Auth0 login endpoints, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.jwk.url
description: auth0.jwk.url is the JWKS URL a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.jwt.claim
description: auth0.jwt.claim is the ID-token claim name a legacy Auth0 installation stored as the login identity, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.logout.url
description: auth0.logout.url is the single sign-out URL a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: auth0.openid.scope
description: auth0.openid.scope is the space-separated OAuth scope list a legacy Auth0 installation stored, and has no declared default.

name: permission.andcondition
description: permission.andcondition (source spells it permission.andCondition; PropertiesEngine lowercases the name on every read/write, same as mail.smtp.clientSecret) is the "Access requires BOTH User and Role permission" (true) vs. "EITHER" (false) switch on Enterprise Manager's repository and Security Actions permission pages, org-scoped. Read fresh from this property on every permission check (ResourcePermissionService), so it takes effect immediately with no restart. Defaults to false (EITHER) when never explicitly set; that default is computed at each read, not persisted, so a deployment that has never touched this property will not show it as an existing stored value.

name: schedule.concurrency
description: schedule.concurrency is the Maximum Concurrent Threads field under Scheduler Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page. It sizes the Quartz thread pool the scheduler creates. Only the lower bound is enforced (Quartz throws below 1); there is no upper bound, so raising it without also raising schedule.memory.max divides the same heap among more simultaneous tasks. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler initializes, not on a running scheduler.

name: scheduler.rmi.port
description: scheduler.rmi.port is the RMI Port Number field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page — the port the scheduler subprocess's RMI registry binds to. The dedicated Scheduler Settings page stops a locally-managed scheduler on its OLD port before saving a change to this value; a bare property write skips that step, so a locally-managed scheduler can become unreachable until it is manually stopped and restarted at the new port. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler subprocess starts.

name: scheduler.classpath
description: scheduler.classpath is the Scheduler Classpath field on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page — the Java classpath used to launch the scheduler as a local subprocess. It is spliced onto the subprocess's -classpath argument with no format validation, so a bad value breaks only the NEXT scheduler subprocess launch (Start/Restart on the Scheduler status page), not one already running.

name: schedule.options.notificationemail
description: schedule.options.notificationemail is the Notification Email checkbox under Schedule Options on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page: whether a task author may set a per-task notification address. It is a per-task-author permission gate only, ANDed with a per-user SCHEDULE_OPTION permission check, and takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.savetodisk
description: schedule.options.savetodisk is the Save to Disk checkbox under Schedule Options: whether a task author may add a save-to-disk action when composing a task. It does not disable saving in a task that already has such an action. Per-task-author permission gate only; takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.emaildelivery
description: schedule.options.emaildelivery is the Email Delivery checkbox under Schedule Options: whether a task author may add an email-delivery action, and whether the viewsheet viewer's own simple-schedule dialog offers it. Per-task-author permission gate only; takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.emailbrowserenable
description: schedule.options.emailbrowserenable is the Enable Email Browser checkbox under Schedule Options: whether the email fields on a scheduled task offer a directory-browse button instead of requiring addresses to be typed. Unlike its three sibling Schedule Options checkboxes, it has no accompanying per-user permission check. Takes effect on the next request with no restart.

name: schedule.options.sharetaskingroup
description: schedule.options.sharetaskingroup is the Share Tasks Between Users in Same Group checkbox under Schedule Options: whether users can see and work with tasks owned by other members of their own group. It does nothing when security is disabled, and also controls whether the Modify By Owner Only checkbox (schedule.options.deletetaskonlybyowner) is shown on the Scheduler page. Takes effect on the next permission check with no restart.

name: schedule.options.deletetaskonlybyowner
description: schedule.options.deletetaskonlybyowner is the Modify By Owner Only checkbox under Schedule Options: whether a shared task may be deleted only by its owner rather than any group member. It has no effect unless schedule.options.sharetaskingroup is also on and security is enabled. Takes effect on the next permission check with no restart.

name: schedule.memory.min
description: schedule.memory.min is the Minimum (MB) field under Memory Usage on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page, spliced into the scheduler subprocess's -Xms flag. It is never cross-validated against schedule.memory.max by the server — only the browser's form checks min <= max — so an inverted or otherwise invalid pair is accepted silently and only fails the next scheduler launch. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler subprocess starts.

name: schedule.memory.max
description: schedule.memory.max is the Maximum (MB) field under Memory Usage on Enterprise Manager's Settings > Schedule > Settings page, spliced into the scheduler subprocess's -Xmx flag. It is never cross-validated against schedule.memory.min by the server; see that property for the same hazard. Takes effect only the next time the scheduler subprocess starts.

name: schedule.save.autosuffix
description: schedule.save.autosuffix is the Save File Suffix field under Schedule Options: text appended to the base name of every file a scheduled task saves to disk, passed through MessageFormat with {0}=asset name, {1}=creation date, {2}=running principal. Takes effect on the very next save with no restart.

name: schedule.options.scheduleisdown
description: schedule.options.scheduleisdown is the Notify on Scheduler Down checkbox under Notification: whether StyleBI emails an alert when the monitor thread finds the scheduler not running. It needs schedule.status.check.email to name a recipient and a mail transport configured, or nothing is sent. Takes effect on the monitor thread's next pass (polls every ten minutes).

name: schedule.options.taskfailed
description: schedule.options.taskfailed is the Notify on Task Failure checkbox under Notification: whether StyleBI emails an alert when a scheduled task throws. It needs schedule.status.check.email to name a recipient and a mail transport configured, or nothing is sent. Takes effect on the next task failure with no restart.

name: schedule.status.check.email
description: schedule.status.check.email is the Email Addresses field under Notification: the recipient list, comma- or semicolon-separated, for both the scheduler-down and task-failure alerts. An entry may be a literal address or a user/group name; an unresolvable name is silently dropped rather than failing the send. Takes effect on the next alert with no restart.

name: schedule.status.check.email.subject
description: schedule.status.check.email.subject is the Subject field under Notification: the subject line of the scheduler-down alert only (the task-failure alert composes its own subject). Clearing the field stores an empty string rather than restoring the shipped default. Takes effect on the next scheduler-down alert.

name: schedule.status.check.email.message
description: schedule.status.check.email.message is the Message field under Notification: the body of the scheduler-down alert only (the task-failure alert composes its own body). Clearing the field stores an empty string rather than restoring the shipped default. Takes effect on the next scheduler-down alert.
